description: This is the main launcher class for a web application using embedded Tomcat server. It initializes and starts a Tomcat server, sets up a context and servlet mapping for MyBankController, and starts the server.

classes.name: AppLauncher
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing and starting the embedded Tomcat server and configuring servlet mappings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; configures and starts the embedded Tomcat server, sets context and servlet mappings.
